mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% within 3 months indicates a tightening labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real estate sales (HOUST) by more than 5% over 3 months signals a strengthening housing market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% over 3 months signals a weakening supply side, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to reduced corporate earnings.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.3% within the same month, it signals a robust labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 200,000 and UNRATE decreases > 0.3% in 1 month
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail sales (RSAFS) by more than 5% over 3 months, coupled with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% within the same period, signals a strengthening consumer demand and labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increases > 5% and UNRATE decreases > 0.5% in 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) by more than 2% over 3 months signals rising inflation, which can lead to monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: An always-on signal where a positive GDP growth rate (GDPC1) indicates a healthy economy, which supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where GDP is positive.
